tips.text: Do one to a few rounds, extract, and re-queue; your drop chance never improves with depth.
Activate all four conduits every round; no key inserted means no Demolisher and no roll.
Farm Akarius and Acceltra in the same Ur sessions; they share the same Demolisher table.
Bring hard crowd control or slows: Nova's Molecular Prime, Cold procs, Magus Lockdown, Khora Ensnare or Harrow Condemn.
Mod Slash or Heat instead of Viral; the usual anti-Infested Viral build underperforms on Demolishers.
Kill Demolishers with high single-target damage from range; do not melee them up close.
Expect slower kills with a weak squad; Demolisher health scales up with squad size.
Expect about an hour of Disruption on average, with a real chance of it going much longer; there is no pity timer.
